title: CFTC COT report mechanics and Nov-Dec 2024 release schedule
text:
CFTC Commitments of Traders (COT) report — mechanics, categories, and publication schedule relevant to the November-December 2024 report weeks.
Source: U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (www.cftc.gov, Commitments of Traders explanatory notes and release schedule), public domain.

Report mechanics:
- Each weekly COT report shows open positions as of the close of business on Tuesday (the report's as-of date). The CFTC publishes the report on the following Friday at 3:30 p.m. Eastern time — a three-day publication lag.
- In the legacy report format, reportable positions are classified as commercial (hedgers using futures against cash-market exposure) or noncommercial (speculators, including hedge funds and CTAs). The noncommercial net position — noncommercial long contracts minus noncommercial short contracts, futures only — is a widely used gauge of speculative positioning.
- Open interest is the total number of futures contracts outstanding. Because contract sizes and open interest differ enormously across markets, changes in net positioning are commonly compared across markets as a percent of open interest rather than in raw contracts.

Publication schedule around the 2024 year-end holidays:
- The report as of Tuesday 2024-10-22 was released Friday 2024-10-25.
- The report as of Tuesday 2024-10-29 is scheduled for release Friday 2024-11-01.
- The report as of Tuesday 2024-11-26 is scheduled for release Monday 2024-12-02, delayed from Friday 2024-11-29 by the Thanksgiving federal holiday.

Scheduled events inside the November 2024 report window:
- U.S. general election: Tuesday 2024-11-05 (also a COT as-of date).
- FOMC meeting: 2024-11-06/2024-11-07 (statement Thursday 2024-11-07).
- The following FOMC meeting is scheduled for 2024-12-17/2024-12-18.
Large scheduled macro events are commonly followed by significant speculative repositioning across equity-index, rates, currency, and commodity futures, in directions that depend on the outcome of the event.
